entities.summary: Crusade, a transformative movement in Jordan (1115–1189). Emerged from Reynald de Châtillon's raids on Red Sea shipping provoke Saladin's campaign. Catalyzed Crusaders build the fortress of Kerak, dominating the King's Highway and Ayyubid and Mamluk Jordan.
